stories.title: Mau shooting follow-up: accused dies in Prayagraj; family protests, seeks CBI probe
stories.summary: After the Sunday night shooting in Jorwara village under Mau police station, Chitrakoot, in which Manoj Kumari was killed and her husband Shyamlal critically injured, accused Shyam Adhar Mishra (booked earlier over a 17-year-old girl's molestation complaint) died during treatment in Prayagraj. The woman's postmortem showed bullet marks but no bullet was recovered even after X-ray; an FIR names the deceased accused, his father Dinesh Chandra and Pankaj Kumar Pandey. Relatives protested after the body returned, demanded a CBI probe, compensation and protection, and alleged police had undercharged the earlier complaint.

stories.title: Stanley Road assault over car scratch; accused allegedly demand ₹25,000
stories.summary: Sunil Kumar Yadav of Holagarh, Soraon, alleged that Mohammad Asad alias Billu, Mohammad Najaf alias Sweetie and several companions beat him on Stanley Road over a car scratch on 8 October, tried to throttle him, and mistreated advocate Kamlesh Chaurasia's elderly mother when she intervened. He also alleged they threatened to shoot him if he filed an FIR and demanded ₹25,000. Cantt police have registered a case.

stories.title: Pahari police recover minor girl reported abducted five days earlier
stories.summary: Pahari police in Chitrakoot recovered a minor Hindu girl who, according to police, had been taken away by a Muslim youth. Parents had filed a complaint at Pahari station five days earlier. Station in-charge Nishikant Rai said she was found after a continuous search and later returned to her parents; further legal action is continuing.

stories.title: Meja youth missing from Prayagraj station found dead near Lakshagrih Ghat
stories.summary: The body of Kumar Gaurav (about 21), a GD Pant Polytechnic student from Ameliya Kala in Meja and son of an NSG commando, was found Monday near Pakke Ghat at Lakshagrih in the Handia area. He had told his mother he was taking a Rapido home after getting off at Prayagraj station around 9 October, then his phone went dead. Police recovered a phone and room key from the body, sent it for postmortem, and are investigating; the family suspects foul play.

stories.title: Jewellery, cash and three phones stolen from SSF constable's Kalindipuram home
stories.summary: SSF constable Dilip Kumar, posted at the civil airport and living in a rented house in Kalindipuram, reported that gold jewellery worth about ₹3 lakh, ₹14,000 cash, three mobile phones, a bag and clothes were stolen overnight while the family slept. The theft was noticed around 4:45 am when he got up for duty. Dhumanjganj police have registered a case and begun an investigation.

stories.title: Bike rider dies in hit-and-run near Chulhi in Manikpur
stories.summary: Jagmohan (55), a resident of Chulhi village, was fatally injured late Sunday night when an unknown vehicle hit his motorcycle near Chulhi in the Manikpur police station area of Chitrakoot while he was returning from an invitation. Manikpur police are trying to identify the vehicle; the body was postmortemed Monday afternoon and handed to the family.

stories.title: Woman shot dead in Mau-area village after family reported niece's molestation; uncle critical, accused shoots himself
stories.summary: In a village under Mau police station, Chitrakoot, Shyam Adhar Mishra, booked a day earlier for molesting a 17-year-old Dalit girl (molestation, POCSO and SC/ST Act charges) and released on bail, allegedly entered the girl's uncle's house around 9:30 pm on Sunday and fired several rounds. The girl's aunt died and her uncle was critically injured and referred to Prayagraj; the accused later shot himself and was also referred to Prayagraj. The family accused police of negligence, and SP Arun Kumar Singh visited the spot.

stories.title: Pilgrims' Bolero falls into Jhuri river; two dead, four hurt
stories.summary: A Bolero carrying pilgrims from Kanpur to Maihar fell into the Jhuri river on the Madhya Pradesh side of Chitrakoot. Two people died and four were injured.

stories.title: Jewellery, cash worth about ₹2.5 lakh stolen from house in Mishrabandh, Kaundhiyara
stories.summary: Thieves entered a house in Mishrabandh, under Kaundhiyara police station in Prayagraj, through the roof around 2 am, broke locks and took gold jewellery, cash and household appliances. Owner Nikhil Singh estimates the loss at about ₹2.5 lakh and has asked police for an impartial investigation and recovery.

stories.title: Four including pregnant woman hurt in attack over old feud in Peepalgaon; seven booked
stories.summary: In Shaha alias Peepalgaon, Prayagraj, seven people allegedly entered a house over an old feud and attacked the family with sticks and iron rods. Four people including a pregnant woman were injured, and complainant Arun Pal and his father are said to be in serious condition. A case has been registered against seven people at the Airport police station.

stories.title: Cantt police arrest four near Beli Kachhar, seize country-made pistol
stories.summary: Prayagraj Cantt police arrested four accused, Rishu Gautam, Akshay Kesari alias Lucky, Mohammad Arshad alias Arshad Kaliya and Subhash Yadav alias Bhondu, near a restaurant at Beli Kachhar in an existing case. A .315-bore country-made pistol and a live cartridge were recovered from Akshay Kesari, and Arms Act charges were added. Two of the accused have prior criminal records.

stories.title: Businessman's wife kept in 'digital arrest' for 10 days, cheated of ₹13.5 lakh
stories.summary: Cybercriminals posing as Delhi Police officers threatened a Prayagraj businessman's wife with a money-laundering case and jail for her family, keeping her under 'digital arrest' for about 10 days. She was cheated of ₹13.5 lakh. The cyber police station has registered a case and started an investigation.

stories.title: Attempted-murder accused Anshu Singh arrested in Jhunsi with illegal pistol
stories.summary: Jhunsi police arrested Anshu Singh, an accused in an attempted-murder case and resident of Barethi Balrampur under Utraon police station, from Kanihar Bandhwa Tahirpur. An illegal .32-bore pistol and a live cartridge were recovered from him.

stories.title: 14-year-old calls 112 to free mother held captive at home in Raipura's Ramnagar
stories.summary: In Ramnagar village under Raipura police station, Chitrakoot, a 14-year-old boy called UP 112 after hearing his mother crying for help while confined in a room at home. The PRV team freed her; she had minor injuries. She has filed an FIR against her husband, who was not found at the spot.

stories.title: Youth Rohit Patel killed over money dispute in Sangramgarh
stories.summary: A youth, Rohit Patel, was killed over a money dispute in Sangramgarh, Prayagraj.

stories.title: Woman returning from SRN hospital gang-raped in Karchhana; auto driver arrested
stories.summary: A woman returning from SRN hospital was gang-raped in Karchhana, Prayagraj. An auto driver is among those arrested and one more accused has been jailed. Two other accused are being sought.

stories.title: Villagers camping near Lohda beaten and robbed; DIG, SP visit scene
stories.summary: Unknown attackers beat and robbed villagers who were camping near Lohda village in the Pahari area of Chitrakoot. The DIG and SP visited the scene following the robbery.

stories.title: UP STF, Maharashtra police arrest two in Naini for Thane murder of Shiv Sena leader
stories.summary: The UP STF and Maharashtra police arrested two people in Naini, Prayagraj. The arrests are linked to the murder of a Shiv Sena leader in Thane.

stories.title: Thieves cutting girders at closed Bargarh glass factory flee, abandon tractor
stories.summary: Unknown thieves broke the wall of a closed glass factory in Bargarh police station area late on Saturday night and were cutting iron girders with a gas cutter and loading them onto a tractor. When Dial 112 police gave chase, they abandoned the tractor in the Paranu Baba forest and fled. Mau SDM Ram Rishi Raman inspected the site and a case against unknown persons is being registered.

stories.title: Son beats 70-year-old mother to death in Bakta Khurd, flees with wife
stories.summary: In Bakta Khurd village under Sardhuwa police station, Chitrakoot, a younger son named Jugal allegedly beat his 70-year-old mother Sanwariya Devi to death with sticks during a family dispute late on Saturday night. He fled the village with his wife. Police have registered a murder case and are raiding possible hideouts.

stories.title: POCSO gang-rape accused wanted since 2022 caught near Mauaima station
stories.summary: Rahul (25), accused in a POCSO and gang-rape case and wanted since 2022, was caught near Mauaima railway station in Prayagraj.

stories.title: Pickup hits pilgrims walking to Maihar; one dead, two hurt
stories.summary: A pickup vehicle hit pilgrims who were walking to Maihar. One person died and two were injured.

stories.title: Armed gang ties up father and daughter, loots ₹1 lakh
stories.summary: An armed gang of six or more attackers tied up a father and his daughter with a sheet in Chitrakoot. The attackers assaulted them with a sword. The gang looted ₹1 lakh.

stories.title: Student molestation accused arrested after CCTV footage
stories.summary: Police in Prayagraj arrested a man accused of molesting a student. The arrest followed CCTV footage of the incident.

stories.title: Mauaima woman alleges abduction to Nashik, 20 days' captivity and rape
stories.summary: A woman from Mauaima, Prayagraj, alleges that three men abducted her to Nashik. She says the main accused held her captive for 20 days and raped her on the promise of marriage. An FIR has been filed.

stories.title: Biker falls about 20 ft off Jagatpur flyover on Prayagraj–Varanasi highway
stories.summary: A biker fell about 20 feet off the Jagatpur flyover on the Prayagraj–Varanasi highway. The rider is in critical condition.

stories.title: Bharatkup police arrest rape accused Aman Kalar
stories.summary: Bharatkup police have arrested Aman Kalar, accused of rape. A 22-year-old woman had gone with him on September 29. The rape section 64(1) was added to the case after her statement in court.

stories.title: Bike rider injured in hit-and-run in Mau
stories.summary: A youth riding a bike was hit by an unknown vehicle in Mau, Chitrakoot. The injured youth was sent to the district hospital. Mau police are investigating the hit-and-run.

stories.title: Sardhuwa teen accuses man of luring her to Delhi and raping her
stories.summary: A 16-year-old girl in Sardhuwa, Chitrakoot, has accused Indrajeet Nishad (24) of luring her to Delhi with a promise of marriage and raping her. A case has been filed.

stories.title: Two arrested for firing in Bahadurpur, pistol seized
stories.summary: Police arrested two men, Aman Patel and Anil Patel, for a firing incident in Bahadurpur, Karwi. A 315-bore pistol was seized.

stories.title: Woman lured into Manikpur forest and gang-raped; three arrested
stories.summary: A woman was lured into the Manikpur forest by a neighbour and gang-raped by three men. All three accused were later arrested.
